one_liner: Mikal Bridges logged 8,529 minutes across 244 games in the three-season window -- the largest minute total of any player in the 482-player NBA atlas.
three_things: Availability is the headline: 244 games and the biggest minute load in this atlas.
The production is complementary rather than central -- 17.7 points per 36 minutes on 36.6 percent from three.
Free-throw accuracy of 81.6 percent rounds out a steady, low-variance profile.
context_note: Per-36-minute rates over a 3-season sample (seasons_played: 3), not per-game and not full-career figures. The manifest is descriptive_only: no adjustment for opponent, teammates, role, or shot difficulty, and a career_min_minutes>=800 inclusion floor applies. Games and minutes measure availability, not how well those minutes were used. The minutes ranking was computed by sorting all 482 atlas entries on career_minutes; every printed number is read straight from the manifest.
